scope: Model/editor Quality v3 remediation review of EN-A1-L-0141; not an independent human or real-learner test.

englishNaturalness.evidence: Target uses “I am late.” and “She is late too.” are short, natural English for the scenario; dialogue turns were checked for agreement, tense, articles and punctuation.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: late is consistently represented as «دیر» in the selected sense, and Persian prompts preserve the English task meaning without adding unsupported context.

pedagogicalClarity.evidence: Dialogue-dependent tasks are ordered after exposure, duplicate exact-sentence assessment is practice-only, and hidden-answer retrieval remains the strongest evidence.

distractorQuality.evidence: Choice distractors are grammatical, natural alternatives that change meaning or information rather than relying on malformed English.

dialoguePlausibility.evidence: Generic story metadata was replaced where needed by scene copy grounded in the canonical setting and turns.

difficultyFit.evidence: One new A1 lexical target (late) plus one bounded grammar construction and one due review item keeps the load controlled.

repetitionUsefulness.evidence: Repeated exact target sentences may remain for practice, but only the strongest occurrence is scored; this reduces false mastery from repeated identical answers.

transferQuality.evidence: The lesson moves from “I am late.” to “She is late too.”, changing the information while preserving the target sense or construction.

overallCoherence.evidence: Scenario, target construction, dialogue and activities all support the stated outcome for late and grammar key CEFRJ-GRAM-58.

learnerExperience.evidence: Runtime ordering and answer tolerance were improved, but no real learner test is claimed.

runtimeAssetGrounding.evidence: No image, photo or visual claim exists. Every listening/replay activity references T01–T04 turns marked audioRequired and first exposed through A02; no listening task points to an unreferenced media object.

limitations: No independent human or real learner test has been performed.
